name: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell gpt-oss-120B Q8 token-gen @4K (Hardware Corner)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Hardware Corner llama.cpp llama-bench). Q8 GGUF, CUDA, batch-1 decode @4K; 123 t/s @128K on the same card. 96GB GDDR7, ~1,790 GB/s, no FlashAttention-4.
notes: The only single card that runs 120B+ class models locally at usable speed. $/tok-s is the worst in the consumer table for small models but unmatched capacity; ~$8,500-8,800 Oct-2026.
